discovery.note: SunSpec uses a MODEL DISCOVERY mechanism. Registers are NOT at fixed absolute addresses — they must be discovered at runtime by walking the model chain.
discovery.anchor_note: Address 40000 (0-indexed Modbus) must contain the 'SunS' marker: 0x5375 0x6E53. Some devices use base 0 or 2 — check device documentation.
discovery.model_header: Each model block starts with 2 registers: [Model_ID (uint16)] + [Length (uint16)]. Data registers immediately follow.
discovery.end_marker: Model ID = 0xFFFF signals end of model chain.

typical_layout.note: Absolute addresses beyond Model 1 depend on which models the device implements.

scale_factor_note: SunSpec uses 'sunssf' scale factor registers (type int16). Physical value = raw_value × 10^SF. Example: raw=1234, SF=-2 → 12.34. SF registers are listed in each model and must be read alongside data registers.

models.name: Common
models.description: Mandatory on all SunSpec devices. Contains device identification.

registers.name: Manufacturer
registers.note: 32-character ASCII string, null-padded. Well-known value registered with SunSpec for compliance.

models.name: Inverter (Single Phase)
models.description: Single phase inverter monitoring. Use model 103 for three-phase devices.

registers.name: Vendor Operating State
registers.note: Vendor-specific state code. Consult device manual.

models.name: Inverter (Three Phase)
models.description: Three-phase inverter monitoring. Most common model for string/central inverters.
models.note: Layout identical to Model 101 except AphB/AphC and PhVphB/PhVphC are mandatory. Added PPVphAB/BC/CA for phase-to-phase voltages.

models.name: Basic Storage Controls
models.description: Battery/storage control and monitoring. Present on inverters with integrated storage management.

registers.name: Minimum Reserve (SOC)
registers.note: Minimum SOC reserve as % of nominal capacity.

registers.name: State of Charge
registers.note: Currently available energy as percent of capacity rating.

registers.name: Available Storage
registers.note: ChaState minus MinRsvPct, times capacity rating.

models.name: Multiple MPPT Inverter Extension
models.description: Per-string (MPPT input) monitoring for multi-string inverters. Contains a fixed header block + N repeating module blocks.

registers_fixed_block.name: Number of MPPT Modules
registers_fixed_block.note: Number of repeating module blocks that follow.

models.name: Three Phase (abc) Meter
models.description: AC energy meter / CT clamp. Used to measure grid import/export. Present on inverters with external CT or smart meter.
models.note: Also use model 201 (single phase) or 202 (split single phase) for other topologies. Full register list has 105 registers — only most useful are listed here. See https://github.com/sunspec/models for complete spec.

registers.name: Total Real Power
registers.note: Positive = import from grid, negative = export to grid.
